scope: Full 7-table extraction of IREIT Global FY2024 (31 Dec 2024 FYE). Presentation currency EUR ('EUR'000' throughout the audited statements, confirmed p183 note 1: 'The financial statements are presented in Euro'). All figures native EUR, not converted.

sources.financial: Consolidated Statement of Total Return p175; Statement of Financial Position (Group) p174; Consolidated Statement of Cash Flows p179. Notes: gross revenue 3.2 (p197), property operating expenses 3.3 (p198), finance costs 3.4 (p198), management fees 3.5 (p199), other trust expenses 3.6 (p200), investment properties/capex 2.4 (p189-190), EPU 3.8.
sources.properties: Statement of Portfolio p180-182 (carrying value column, EUR'000 x1000). 53 active properties + Il·lumina (divested 31 Jan 2024). category assigned by geography (Germany/Spain office campuses, France Decathlon/B&M retail).
sources.tenants_trade: Top 10 Tenants and Trade Sectors donut tables, by gross rental income, p47.
sources.performance: Financial Review / highlights p22, Statement of Distribution p176, financial review p1075 (ICR/cost of debt/debt maturity).

reconciliation.balance_sheet: total_liabilities 432,734k + total_equity (net assets attributable to unitholders) 528,655k = 961,389k = total_asset. PASS.

derived_metrics.net_property_sales: -224k = loss on divestment of Il·lumina investment property (Note 2.3). Signed.

signs.expenses: cost_of_revenue, operating_expense, income_taxes, interest_expense_non_operating stored POSITIVE.
signs.perpetual_minorities: No perpetual securities and no non-controlling interests in this trust; total return is 100% attributable to Unitholders. perpetual_security_holders=null, minorities=null, unitholders=net_income.

columns_never_fillable.column: occupancy_rate / gfa / nla / gross_revenue / major_tenants (per property)
columns_never_fillable.evidence: Statement of Portfolio (p180-182) discloses only land tenure, location, remaining leasehold term, carrying value and % of net assets per property. Per-property operating metrics are not tabulated; occupancy is disclosed only at country level (Germany 80.9%, Spain 75.4%, France 100.0%, p238-260) and per-property NLA/revenue are not disclosed in a machine-extractable per-property grid.
Not disclosed per property in this report; only the FY2023 B&M portfolio acquisition price (82,424k for 17 French retail properties) is given in aggregate (Note 2.4).

inferred: property.category: assigned by geography (Germany + Spain = Office campuses/business parks; France = Retail, the Decathlon and B&M retail portfolios). The Statement of Portfolio does not print an asset-class column; classification confirmed from the portfolio narrative (Decathlon/B&M retail, p47/p2521) and asset descriptions.
trade_mix 'Others' (9.5%) mapped to canonical 'Other Office Trades' as a residual catch-all bucket (verbatim label 'Others' retained in category_raw); the disclosed table has no finer breakdown.

weighted_avg_shares_basic/diluted = 1,344,838,000 = units in issue (constant through FY2024, no issuance); EPU note states basic = diluted. Cross-checks to disclosed EPU 0.64 EUR cents (8,603k / 1,344,838k = 0.64).
anomalies: Berlin Campus 'Other income' 10,475k includes a 15.5m dilapidation payment from the main tenant recognised straight-line Jul-2023 to Dec-2024 (Note 3.2) - inflates FY2024 gross revenue; disclosed, not an error.

Change in fair value of investment properties is a LOSS of 19,375k (European commercial revaluation down) - drives FFO (28,202k) ABOVE net income (8,603k), which is correct per NAREIT convention in a revaluation-loss year.
Distributions to Unitholders (25,568k) exceed total return for the year (8,603k); the trust distributes from tax-adjusted distributable income (28,409k), normal for a REIT.
data_with_no_home: Country-level occupancy (Germany 80.9%, Spain 75.4%, France 100.0%, p238-260) has no per-property home in the schema; recorded in performance.flags.
Lease expiry profile by GRI (p2529) and WALE 4.9yr (p2633) captured at portfolio level (performance.wale).
parsing_traps: Statement of Portfolio spans 3 pages (180-182) with France split by carried-forward/brought-forward subtotal rows; those subtotal + section-total rows are skipped in the deterministic parse. 53 active property rows + Il·lumina (divested) = 54.
Il·lumina divested 31 Jan 2024 is absent from the FY2024 Statement of Portfolio; added as a divested property row and a property_transaction from Note 2.3 (p189).

4 French properties are Leasehold (Noyelles-Godault, Maizières-lès-Metz, Fayet, Blois) with a remaining-term column but no expiry date printed; lease_expiry_date null, lease_term_years from the Remaining Term column.
